headline: SPIC Q2 profit drops 23% despite revenue growth
hook: Rising costs erode SPIC's quarterly margins
summary: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation (SPIC) reported a 23% decline in consolidated net profit to ₹47 crore for the second quarter. Revenue grew by 22% during the same period. The company attributed the profit contraction to rising input costs impacting margins. This performance highlights the ongoing margin pressure faced by fertilizer manufacturers.
why_it_matters: Rising input costs may continue to squeeze fertilizer company margins.
winners_losers: Input suppliers gain / SPIC shareholders hurt

headline: SPIC submits unaudited financial results for Q2 FY27
hook: Second quarter scorecard from Southern Petrochemicals
summary: Southern Petrochemicals Industries Corporation Limited has submitted its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, to the exchange. The company disclosed its operational and financial performance through a press release filed on November 5, 2026. Retail investors tracking the fertilizer sector can review these numbers to assess margin trends and revenue growth. Quarterly earnings releases provide crucial inputs for evaluating the company's operational health and future outlook.
why_it_matters: Q2 earnings figures reveal the fertilizer maker's operational profitability.

headline: SPIC declares financial results for the quarter ended September 2026
hook: September quarter numbers out at SPIC
summary: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation has submitted its un-audited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing covers the company's financial performance during the second quarter of the fiscal year. These routine periodic filings provide baseline performance data for public shareholders and analysts tracking the fertilizer sector. Retail investors holding the stock should review the margin performance and revenue figures in the detailed financial filing.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides near-term stock price movement.
